dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.reviewEmptyHint: New businesses and drafts show up here.

partners.title: Partner businesses
partners.sub: Create accounts when a partnership starts, or verify businesses that signed up on their own. Until verified, their offers stay as drafts.
partners.emptyHint: Businesses that sign up on their own appear under “To verify”.
partners.verified: Business verified. Its content is now public.
partners.rejected: Business rejected. Its content stays as drafts.
partners.suspended: Business suspended. Its offers and events no longer appear in the app.
partners.rejectHint: The business's offers, events and announcements stay as drafts. You can still verify it later.
partners.suspendHint: The business's published offers, events and announcements go back to drafts until you verify it again.
partners.reasonPh: E.g. the business details don't match

form.title: New partner business
form.sub: Create the account when the partnership starts. The business gets an activation invitation by e-mail.
form.name: Business name
form.addressHint: On the map the business shows in the centre of Arad until it sets its location in its profile.
form.submit: Create the account and send the invitation
form.inviteText: “Welcome to AradExperience! Activate your partner account to publish offers.”

created.title: Account created
created.text: The invitation to {email} was sent (simulated). One-time password:
created.note: You can't see the password again after closing this. Send it to the business over a secure channel.

content.title: Content & moderation
content.sub: Everything in the app, whoever organises it. The admin can publish or hide anything.
content.emptyHint: Change the filter or the search.

toast.PUBLISHED: Published. It now appears in the app.
toast.HIDDEN: Hidden. It no longer appears in the app.
toast.DRAFT: Moved back to draft. It no longer appears in the app.

users.title: Users
users.sub: {n} accounts · {visitors} visitors · {locals} locals · {firms} businesses · {city} city hall · {volunteers} volunteers · {admins} admin
users.search: Search by name, e-mail or phone
users.footnote: Details: change the role (e.g. give City Hall to an employee), adjust points with a note, disable the account. No passwords or payment data.

sheet.roleLocked: Business, volunteer and your own roles can't be changed here.
sheet.selfLock: You can't disable your own account.
sheet.errPoints: Enter a whole number other than 0 (e.g. +25 or -10).

settings.title: Settings
settings.sub: Thresholds, integrations, languages. The values come from the server configuration and change on deploy.
settings.ai: Claude (chat, itinerary) · key only in the backend
settings.maps: Google Maps + OSRM (map, walking and driving routes)

errors.emailTaken: An account with this e-mail already exists.
errors.selfRole: You can't change your own role.
errors.selfDisable: You can't disable your own account.
errors.businessRole: Business accounts are managed in “Partner businesses”.
errors.volunteerRole: Volunteer accounts are created by City Hall.
errors.insufficientPoints: The balance can't go below zero.
